transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in to see me?

I can’t shake the belief that my spouse and friends have been secretly plotting behind my back, no matter how much they deny it. It has caused a lot of tension in my relationship, and after couples therapy stalled, it was recommended that I come here for an individual evaluation.
Have you always tended to be suspicious and mistrustful of other people, or did these beliefs about your spouse and friends being against you start more recently?

No, I haven't always been a suspicious person at all. This only started about a year and nine months ago during a stressful store remodel when my spouse and I were arguing a lot. But since that time, I am absolutely certain they have been secretly plotting and testing me.
Have you ever had hallucinations, heard voices, or noticed any other unusual experiences that others around you did not seem to share?

No, I've never heard voices or seen things that weren't there. I don't experience hallucinations at all, so my concerns are strictly about the actual things my spouse and friends are doing and saying behind my back.

Besides your spouse and friends, do you believe anyone else is involved in this plotting, or has this belief stayed focused on just a few specific people? Also, has it affected your work, finances, or day-to-day functioning in other ways?

No, it's strictly limited to my spouse and those specific friends, and I don't believe coworkers or strangers are involved at all. My work as a retail supervisor, my finances, and my daily responsibilities are completely unaffected and running smoothly. The strain is entirely confined to my marriage and those close friendships.
Have you ever felt that the same people are controlling your thoughts, inserting thoughts into your mind, or that your thoughts are being broadcast to others?
No, I have never felt like anyone is controlling my thoughts or inserting things into my mind. I've also never experienced my thoughts being broadcasted to others; my thoughts are entirely my own.

Have these beliefs ever led you to do things like confront them repeatedly, check on them, or take steps to protect yourself, or have they stayed as a firm belief without much change in your behavior?

Yes, they have definitely changed how I act. I find myself constantly confronting my spouse, asking to see their phone messages, and scanning social media posts and everyday conversations for coded signs. This has led to repeated arguments and a lot of strain in both my marriage and my friendships.
Have these beliefs been present continuously for at least 1 month, and have you ever had any other psychotic symptoms such as hallucinations or disorganized speech during that time?

Yes, these beliefs have been going on continuously for about a year and nine months now. I've never had any other symptoms like hearing voices, seeing things, or having trouble organizing my thoughts or speaking. The issue is strictly limited to my suspicions about my spouse and friends.
